summary_1line: Bhishma instructs Yudhishthira on royal duties: self-mastery, intelligence networks, justice, taxation, war strategy, and defensive measures to protect the kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: An ancient king sits in council while disguised spies—posing as beggars, fools, and blind men—quietly observe the bustling city around him.
A fortified city stands with water-filled trenches lined with stakes and crocodiles while soldiers place weapons on the ramparts.
Bhishma, lying on a bed of arrows, instructs Yudhishthira about the discipline and burdens of kingship.
